csv_project_name: Developer for Columbine Neighborhood Housing Development
csv_scope_of_work: The Town is seeking a qualified development partner to design and program deed-restricted community housing on the Columbine Neighborhood site, from initial concept through to a permit-ready plan set. This RFP is for Phase I of the project. The emphasis is on predevelopment producing a thoughtfully designed site plan and architectural concept and establishing the broad, underlying project and budget structure that will be needed to guide future financing and construction.
